ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, it is known that point $B$ is on line segment $AC$, and point $D$ is on line segment $AB$. If $AB=10\, \text{cm}$, $BC=6\, \text{cm}$, and $D$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$, what is the length of line segment $DB$ in $\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in Figure 1 in the problem, \\
since AB=10cm, and BC=6cm, \\
therefore AC=AB+BC=10+6=16cm. \\
Also, since D is the midpoint of segment AC, \\
therefore DC=$\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 16=8$cm, \\
therefore DB=DC−BC=8−6=$\boxed{2}$cm.
